device_entry.name: Thorlabs电动滤光轮
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: 用于控制Thorlabs FW102C及相关型号的电动滤光轮，在显微镜和光学实验中实现不同滤光片位置的切换。该设备可用于快速选择光路中的滤光片，适合荧光成像和一般光学测量场景。
device_entry.description_en: A motorized filter wheel for controlling Thorlabs FW102C and related models, used in microscopy and optical experiments to switch between filter positions. It enables rapid selection of filters in the optical path for fluorescence imaging and general optical measurements.
